witnesses.provenance: Solana's per-transaction MAX_COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT is 1,400,000 compute units. It is the chain's limit, not ours. The whole point of FEE_SECOND_TRANSACTION_V1 is that the fee-bearing trade did not fit under it as ONE transaction; this witness is the standing proof that each half of the pair does.

ProgramTest submits no packet and so enforces no 1,232-byte maximum: an over-wide frame survives a fast lane untouched, which is exactly the defect Found31 was. A campaign claiming the fast lane's second condition must MEASURE the packet. None means the campaign did not measure, which is honest but is not evidence.
Solana's maximum transaction wire size is 1,232 bytes. The fill is the tight one at 1,167; the settlement is 369.

DCLTDFS1 is permissionless by design: a stranger cranks it. FEE_SECOND_TRANSACTION_V1 section 4 estimated 165,000-210,000 CU in an 18-21 account frame. This bound is generous against that estimate on purpose -- it is a regression fence, not the estimate restated -- and the measured figure is ~173,700.
